subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Rina is a very sincere student. (a) ⎯⎯ she finds time, she sits at her table. She does well in her college tests. (b) ⎯⎯, she doesn't forget to take physical exercise. (c) ⎯⎯, her brother Rony is very inattentive to his studies. (d) ⎯⎯, he doesn't do well in his school tests. One day, his father called him and said, "You should be attentive to your studies, (e) ⎯⎯. You won't be able to shine in life.
guide_solution: (a) Whenever (b) Besides/ Moreover (c) On the other hand/ on the contrary (d) So/ As a result/ consequently (e) otherwise
